messages:
sylvia_cs: Quick heads-up  saw a weird jump in healthscores after last night's CRM import. ~40 accounts +20pts, no manual touches logged.

harry_data: can you paste an example?

sylvia_cs: ACCT-8088 prev=42 -> new=71; score reason shows recent_touch bumped. but no outbound activity in our mail logs.

om_priya_ops: did email2crm connector run? we flipped dedupe off in the last deploy for legacy mail threads.

sylvia_cs: email2crm ran at 2025-09-14T02:03Z. notes created: 'Email received: Welcome materials' across many accounts.

playbook-bot: alert: rule "email-route-onboard" triggered 198 times during import window; source=email-connector; dedupe_policy=none.

harry_data: query used to find regressions: ```SELECT account_id, prev_score, new_score FROM health_changes WHERE changed_at >= '2025-09-14' AND abs(new_score - prev_score) > 15;```

om_priya_ops: temp mitigation: we can mark connector notes to not count for recent_touch. ops patch: `POST /ops/connectors/email2crm/config` body `{ "exclude_from_recent_touch": true, "ttl": "6h" }`. should I apply?

kai_eng: i'll add a short-term transform to tag imported notes with `metadata.exclude_from_health=true` and push a backfill to tag last night's 198 rows. PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9011

audit-bot: export ready: s3://cs-exports/email_import_1792103456.csv (198 rows).

sylvia_cs: of the 198, how many renewals <120/30 days? need high-touch list.

harry_data: quick counts: 12 <120d, 3 <30d. I'll split and add owner column then push to enablement.

om_priya_ops: applied temporary config: exclude_from_recent_touch=true (6h). response=202.

kai_eng: staging backfill queued; adding integration test so import notes don't increment recent_touch metric. plan to deploy change to prod in next maintenance window.

sylvia_cs: thanks all. created ticket CS-4521 for postmortem and owner reconciliation. will message enablement with the 3 urgent accounts for manual outreach.
